snippet.title: The Wandering Village 1.0 Launch Date, PlayStation and Physical Edition Reveal
snippet.description: The Wandering Village 1.0 is coming to Steam, Switch 1, Xbox and PlayStation 4 and 5 on July 17th 2025! Plus there will be a Physical Edition of the game by Serenity Forge.
